messages.content: Build a pizzeria site with home, menu, about and contact pages
Swarm mode: the foundation is done. Call delegateTasks now with 2-4 tasks that own the remaining pages and features; writes to worker paths are refused.

tools.name: delegateTasks
tools.description: Run 2-4 tasks in parallel, each by a worker that writes only its owned paths. ownedPaths must be files or folders under src/ or public/ (e.g. src/pages/Home.tsx, src/components/gallery, public), disjoint between tasks. Root config and the shared files (index.html, package.json, src/App.tsx, src/main.tsx, src/index.css, configs) are yours: write them before delegating. Call it once, after writing the shared foundation. Returns each task's report: done, unfinished or failed, the files it wrote, and its NEEDS: requests. A task with role "sub-orchestrator" (at most 2) splits its own paths among up to 3 workers.
